raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-JOR-InnovativeStartupsSMEsFund2",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Geopolitical volatility in the MENA region could disrupt private capital markets, deter regional VC investors, and reduce startup investment flow into Jordan.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Position ISSF as a strategic co-investment partner providing non-subsidized matching capital and side letters to de-risk investment terms for international funds.",
      "evidence": "Jordan’s small, open economy continues to face vulnerabilities tied to its position in a geopolitically volatile region."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High global and local interest rates and VC market downturns may prevent beneficiary startups and funds from mobilizing the targeted $150 million in private capital.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Target diverse early-stage fund models, leverage DFI partnerships such as IFC, and mandate 1x minimum investment multiples in fund side letters.",
      "evidence": "macro challenges (e.g., Covid-19 pandemic, increased interest rates locally and globally, geopolitical tensions in the region)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High turnover of key technical and management personnel in the ISSF PMU could delay capital deployment, M&E reporting, and due diligence execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain competitive market-based compensation structures and institutionalize operational procedures within the Project Operations Manual to retain PMU staff capacity.",
      "evidence": "In the initial years of operation, ISSF faced challenges linked to, for example, high turnover of the team."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Excessive concentration of capital in a single VC fund or large investment could lead to significant financial loss if that intermediary fails.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce strict investment caps per fund (e.g., US$5 million cap and maximum 30% ownership) as updated in the POM and Investment Strategy.",
      "evidence": "To mitigate and manage concentration risks, the current ISSF Investment Strategy sets out the limit on ISSF investment in one VC fund."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Supported ICT startups may improperly manage e-waste and hardware disposal, causing environmental pollution and health and safety risks.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Integrate mandatory environmental screening and good e-waste management/recycling clauses into sub-project legal agreements and the ESMS.",
      "evidence": "SMEs’ supported activities may cause environmental impacts connected to mismanagement of e-waste, including pollution, Occupational Health and Safety"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "ISSF PMU's lack of prior direct experience with the World Bank's ESF standards could result in weak environmental and social risk monitoring across financial intermediaries.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Hire a dedicated Environmental and Social officer and require all partner VC funds to adopt ESMS systems satisfactory to World Bank standards.",
      "evidence": "hence, ISSF requires improved E&S risks and impacts management capacity, especially in the implementation of the World Bank Environmental and Social Standards"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "ICT startups funded by the project may lack non-discrimination, workplace safety, and anti-sexual harassment policies, violating social standards.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate explicit non-discrimination, worker grievance, and SEA/SH prevention requirements into the Project Operations Manual and fund covenants.",
      "evidence": "Additional labor risks related to ICT start-ups include terms and conditions of employment, discrimination, and sexual harassment"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "The current legal corporate duration of ISSF as a Private Shareholding Company ends in 2029, prior to the expected 10-12 year venture investment return lifecycle.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Amend ISSF's Articles of Association prior to effectiveness to convert it into an open-ended Private Shareholding Company.",
      "evidence": "whereas currently the ISSF Private Shareholding Company ‘ends’ in 2029."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "The existing Grievance Mechanism at ISSF may not be fully accessible to all project-affected stakeholders or sub-project workers.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade the GM system with safe, confidential, survivor-centered uptake channels and clear resolution procedures across all portfolio levels.",
      "evidence": "it was found that the GM system requires enhancement to ensure that all affected parties and stakeholders of the project can access it"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Delays in authorizing the Subsidiary Agreement between MOPIC and ISSF or adopting the POM could delay loan effectiveness and capital disbursement.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Complete the authorization of the Subsidiary Agreement and draft POM/Corporate Governance Manual updates as legal conditions precedent to effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "The Subsidiary Agreement has been duly authorized by the Borrower and ISSF and is legally binding"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Direct equity co-investments in startups under Component 2 expose ISSF to total single-venture failure risk and cumulative exposure across components.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Limit Component 2 co-investments to a minority role with a maximum cap of $500,000 following qualified lead institutional investors, and set exposure caps in the POM.",
      "evidence": "consider the risks related to total exposure to the same startups (through Component 1 and Component 2)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High-growth Jordanian startups may relocate their corporate headquarters to GCC countries, diminishing local employment and economic spillover benefits in Jordan.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include strict 'Jordan Investment' definitions and thresholds in Side Letters, requiring portfolio startups to maintain core operational workforce and R&D in Jordan.",
      "evidence": "even though some Jordanian startups relocate their headquarters to GCC countries in later growth stages"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Social norms and legislative hurdles could lead to lower participation and equity investment allocation for youth- and female-led startups.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a dedicated Gender Action Plan, target at least 30% female-led/owned beneficiaries, and partner with IFC programs like Start Mashreq.",
      "evidence": "there is a risk that they may not fully benefit if specific barriers to their participation are not effectively addressed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Underlying VC fund managers may engage in fraudulent practices, mismanagement, or regulatory non-compliance, risking public fund loss.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct rigorous Operational Due Diligence (ODD) prior to fund commitments and maintain ongoing monitoring of portfolio funds' compliance.",
      "evidence": "monitor risks such as fraud, mismanagement, or regulatory non-compliance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "ICT sector startups supported by project capital could suffer data privacy breaches, cybersecurity failures, or aggravate digital access disparities.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Screen tech startups for data protection compliance and require technical due diligence protocols covering data privacy and cybersecurity standards.",
      "evidence": "social risks, including poor labor and working conditions, limited stakeholder engagement, the digital divide, data privacy and security risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Persistent reliance on traditional banking and subdued credit growth in Jordan could reduce availability of follow-on debt financing for growing SMEs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy catalytic risk capital via quasi-equity, convertible notes, and co-investments to bridge the gap left by commercial banking constraints.",
      "evidence": "underscored challenges such as underdeveloped financial instruments and reliance on traditional banking system with a subdued credit growth."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Geopolitical volatility in the MENA region could disrupt private capital markets, deter regional VC investors, and reduce startup investment flow into Jordan.
risks.mitigation: Position ISSF as a strategic co-investment partner providing non-subsidized matching capital and side letters to de-risk investment terms for international funds.
risks.evidence: Jordan’s small, open economy continues to face vulnerabilities tied to its position in a geopolitically volatile region.

risks.description: High global and local interest rates and VC market downturns may prevent beneficiary startups and funds from mobilizing the targeted $150 million in private capital.
risks.mitigation: Target diverse early-stage fund models, leverage DFI partnerships such as IFC, and mandate 1x minimum investment multiples in fund side letters.
risks.evidence: macro challenges (e.g., Covid-19 pandemic, increased interest rates locally and globally, geopolitical tensions in the region)

risks.description: High turnover of key technical and management personnel in the ISSF PMU could delay capital deployment, M&E reporting, and due diligence execution.
risks.mitigation: Maintain competitive market-based compensation structures and institutionalize operational procedures within the Project Operations Manual to retain PMU staff capacity.
risks.evidence: In the initial years of operation, ISSF faced challenges linked to, for example, high turnover of the team.

risks.description: Excessive concentration of capital in a single VC fund or large investment could lead to significant financial loss if that intermediary fails.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict investment caps per fund (e.g., US$5 million cap and maximum 30% ownership) as updated in the POM and Investment Strategy.
risks.evidence: To mitigate and manage concentration risks, the current ISSF Investment Strategy sets out the limit on ISSF investment in one VC fund.

risks.description: Supported ICT startups may improperly manage e-waste and hardware disposal, causing environmental pollution and health and safety risks.
risks.mitigation: Integrate mandatory environmental screening and good e-waste management/recycling clauses into sub-project legal agreements and the ESMS.
risks.evidence: SMEs’ supported activities may cause environmental impacts connected to mismanagement of e-waste, including pollution, Occupational Health and Safety

risks.description: ISSF PMU's lack of prior direct experience with the World Bank's ESF standards could result in weak environmental and social risk monitoring across financial intermediaries.
risks.mitigation: Hire a dedicated Environmental and Social officer and require all partner VC funds to adopt ESMS systems satisfactory to World Bank standards.
risks.evidence: hence, ISSF requires improved E&S risks and impacts management capacity, especially in the implementation of the World Bank Environmental and Social Standards

risks.mitigation: Incorporate explicit non-discrimination, worker grievance, and SEA/SH prevention requirements into the Project Operations Manual and fund covenants.
risks.evidence: Additional labor risks related to ICT start-ups include terms and conditions of employment, discrimination, and sexual harassment

risks.description: The current legal corporate duration of ISSF as a Private Shareholding Company ends in 2029, prior to the expected 10-12 year venture investment return lifecycle.
risks.mitigation: Amend ISSF's Articles of Association prior to effectiveness to convert it into an open-ended Private Shareholding Company.
risks.evidence: whereas currently the ISSF Private Shareholding Company ‘ends’ in 2029.

risks.mitigation: Complete the authorization of the Subsidiary Agreement and draft POM/Corporate Governance Manual updates as legal conditions precedent to effectiveness.

risks.mitigation: Limit Component 2 co-investments to a minority role with a maximum cap of $500,000 following qualified lead institutional investors, and set exposure caps in the POM.
risks.evidence: consider the risks related to total exposure to the same startups (through Component 1 and Component 2)

risks.evidence: monitor risks such as fraud, mismanagement, or regulatory non-compliance.

risks.evidence: social risks, including poor labor and working conditions, limited stakeholder engagement, the digital divide, data privacy and security risks

risks.evidence: underscored challenges such as underdeveloped financial instruments and reliance on traditional banking system with a subdued credit growth.
